title: M0 — Bootstrap & Rules
description: Bootstrap the repository, tracking, CI, independence, and zero-budget rules.

title: M1 — Data & Tokenizer
description: Create provenance-first data ingestion and the first trained tokenizer.

title: M2 — Tiny Baseline Model
description: Train and evaluate the first from-scratch model end to end.

title: M3 — Evaluation Lab
description: Measure quality, regressions, compute, memory, speed, and cost.

title: M4 — Efficiency Research
description: Improve quality per FLOP through controlled architecture experiments.

title: M5 — Self-Improvement Loop
description: Build challenger, verifier, candidate-training, and promotion workflows.

title: M6 — Scale Useful Capability
description: Scale only validated improvements toward a genuinely useful small model.

title: M6A — Weak-Domain Breakthrough
description: Move math and structured transformation capability above the current zero-exact bottleneck using evidence-efficient research.

title: M6B — GCI Capability Improvement
description: Promote checkpoints only when frozen GCI capability improves without unacceptable regression.

title: M6C — Efficient Scaling
description: Scale parameters only after capability-per-compute evidence justifies the larger model.

title: M6D — Autonomous Research System
description: Make remote autonomy scientifically efficient, restartable, traceable, and independent of personal hardware.

title: M7 — Free Serving & Community
description: Provide reproducible zero-cost demos, releases, and contribution workflows.

title: M8 — Frontier Efficiency
description: Long-term research toward frontier-adjacent capability at radically lower inference cost.
